AdmissionRule.block:
model AdmissionRule {
  id                   String             @id @default(cuid())
  programId            String
  academicSession      String
  applicantStage       String
  allowedGroups        String[]
  minimumSscGpa        Decimal?           @db.Decimal(3, 2)
  minimumHscGpa        Decimal?           @db.Decimal(3, 2)
  minimumCombinedGpa   Decimal?           @db.Decimal(4, 2)
  requiredSubjects     Json?
  minimumSubjectGrades Json?
  additionalCriteria   String?
  sourceUrl            String
  effectiveFrom        DateTime?
  effectiveUntil       DateTime?
  verificationStatus   VerificationStatus @default(PENDING)
  verifiedAt           DateTime?
  createdAt            DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt            DateTime           @updatedAt
  program              Program            @relation(fields: [programId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)

  @@unique([programId, academicSession])
  @@index([academicSession])
  @@index([verificationStatus])
}

Scholarship.block:
model Scholarship {
  id                 String             @id @default(cuid())
  institutionId      String?
  programId          String?
  title              String
  provider           String
  description        String?
  eligibility        Json
  amountDescription  String?
  deadline           DateTime?
  sourceUrl          String
  verificationStatus VerificationStatus @default(PENDING)
  createdAt          DateTime           @default(now())
  updatedAt          DateTime           @updatedAt
  institution        Institution?       @relation(fields: [institutionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  program            Program?           @relation(fields: [programId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)

  @@index([deadline])
}

DataSource.block:
model DataSource {
  id            String          @id
  authority     DataAuthority
  name          String
  baseUrl       String
  datasetUrl    String?
  license       String?
  lastCheckedAt DateTime?
  createdAt     DateTime        @default(now())
  updatedAt     DateTime        @updatedAt
  institutions  Institution[]
  programs      Program[]
  importRuns    DataImportRun[]

  @@unique([authority, baseUrl])
}

risks: AdmissionRule cannot represent institution-wide rules without adding institutionId.
AdmissionRule.programId is required; institution-wide rules would require a fake program unless schema changes.
AdmissionRule.academicSession is required but approved fragments do not consistently carry a normalized session.
AdmissionRule.applicantStage is required but approved fragments do not consistently carry a normalized applicant stage.
AdmissionRule has no canonical source lineage fields.
Scholarship has no canonical source lineage fields.
Admission dataset contains fee/cost fragments that should not be forced into AdmissionRule.
Admission dataset contains date/deadline fragments that should not automatically become eligibility rules.

AdmissionRule.reason: Needs schema evolution + reconstruction; only eligibility-type fragments belong here.
suggestedChanges: replace coarse unique(programId, academicSession) with source lineage uniqueness and targeted indexes

fragmentRouting.FEE_OR_COST: separate fee/tuition model or Program tuition enrichment; do not force into AdmissionRule
fragmentRouting.DATE_OR_DEADLINE: deadline/circular/admission-cycle representation; do not force into AdmissionRule

Scholarship.reason: Schema broadly fits entity, but canonical lineage and fragment aggregation are required.
suggestedChanges: aggregate fragment rows into one scholarship/waiver policy entity when evidence supports it
